readable_claim: Execution remains faithful only while every lowering preserves the accepted objective, non-goals, authority, means, stop conditions, evidence, and residuals; a helpful change of means can still violate intent.
normative_rule: Preserve the accepted obligations and current authority through each lowering. Continue allowed choices under an existing valid grant; hold the affected action when it exceeds that envelope or lacks required evidence. Record actual effects, unknown outcomes, and recovery separately. A useful output, complete receipt, or recovery plan cannot substitute for those observations.
